title: Cordelia
body:
![https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/55549/900/1581111423-159804558.jpeg|medium|right](https://www.dndbeyond.com/avatars/55549/900/1581111423-159804558.jpeg)

- Belongs to an offshoot clan to the Valraean Protectorate from the deeper sea (Dark Sea region), with more of a focus on protection of nature - known as the Abyssal Protectorate. These sea elves split from the main faction because they could not justify the oppressive rule of the Valraeans, though they aren't without lingering traces of arrogance at times. The Abyssal Protectorate are smaller in numbers but are each responsible for a fairly large patch of the deep in the Thunder Sea. They strive to protect the natural way of the ocean and dedicate their lives to it, even if it means living a relatively isolated life in darkness to do so.
- Secretly fears that she won't be able to protect the deep on her own.
- Tied to Tidecrown by her zealotry to communicate the importance of the deep and how it can't just be mined for resources.
- Her mother, Lydia, is her former mentor who she aspires to become - she died recently.
- Even though the deep sea Valreans don't enjoy leaving their domain Cordelia has offered to remain in Tidecrown as an ambassador until the safety of the deep is secured. imagines her to be a bit of a deep sea Poison Ivy in terms of motivations.
- She has scheduled sparring sessions with Ghomuth - they know each other from before they both got to the base, and are from the same general area of the sea.

### Motivation and Goals

- [x] Meet each high ranking figure within Tidecrown. ✅ 2026-04-13
- [ ]  Learn about important figures from the surface.
 - This goal relates to the fact that it's House Cannith and House Lyrandar jointly working to start mining the seabed. But just learning about Dragonmarked houses generally would be enough to accomplish this initial goal - as long as at least two approached are taken (such as finding one of their ships, and doing research on a crest in a library).
- [ ]  Convince one non-PACT member in Tidecrown to push for her cause against deep sea mining.
- [ ]  Learn one additional standard language.
 - 9 weeks to learn Aquan
- [ ]  Render a machine or ship used for deep sea mining unusable.
- [ ]  Study Khyber until she learns what is beneath her district of sea floor (Dark Sea).
- [ ]  Wild shape into all of the following at least once: Seahorse, Octopus, Giant crab, Dolphin
